svg.title: The Americas and the world: schools a no-internet touch wall could reach
svg.desc: Share of primary schools without internet: Nicaragua 96.5% (2022), Paraguay 75.8% (2019), Honduras 75.3% (2019), Guatemala 70.3% (2019), Brazil 61.7% (2024), Peru 53.3% (2024), Venezuela 53% (2024), Colombia 52.8% (2022), Panama 51.1% (2024), Ecuador 40.6% (2024), Argentina 35.2% (2023), Dominican Republic 35.2% (2024), Costa Rica 13.7% (2020), Chile 6.9% (2024), El Salvador 5.6% (2019), Uruguay 0% (2023), United States 0% (2019). Worldwide about 60% of primary schools have no internet; nearly half of the world's roughly 6 million schools are unconnected.
svg.text: Beyond Peru: the Americas and the world
Share of primary schools without internet. Every one with a projector or a TV could run Mimikai offline.
Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics via Our World in Data (primary schools with internet for teaching, latest year per country, updated 31 Jul 2026);
Giga (UNICEF–ITU) via Swissinfo, 11 Jul 2024; UNESCO via VOA, 17 Oct 2023. Mexico and countries without recent data are grey. Map: Natural Earth via world-atlas.
